Tui-Len

Overview

Tui-Len is a Joon elder held under Firez’s rule. He explains that fear of the Curse led his people to trust Firez’s promises, and tells Kir that his parents are dead. After his liberation he opens a sealed Joon cave, counsels against hatred and gives advice about allies and the Rod of Life. [1, 2, 3]

The freed Joons and Kir’s family

Kel and Rad discover that Firez is moving the Joon prisoners from the mountain prison into his fortress. Kel plans an attack on the transfer, avoiding a direct prison assault. Among those freed are Tai-Ilara, whom Kir admired as a child, and the elder Tui-Len. Tai-Ilara welcomes his changed appearance and asks him to retrieve belongings left behind. Tui-Len brings harder news: Kir’s parents are dead. The elder fears that killing Firez will expose the survivors to the Curse, but Kir tells him that Tka-Rik and At-Zako have already destroyed it. Tui-Len also opens the sealed Joon cache whose amulet Kir has recovered. [4, 5, 1, 6, 7, 8]

Tai-Ilara’s request and Kel’s death

Seeing Kir reunited with Tai-Ilara, Kel asks for the way back to Suslanger. Kir begs her to stay and mentions one more expedition for Tai-Ilara’s belongings. Kel agrees because she still fears for him, calling it their last adventure together. She dies during that expedition. On Kir’s return, Tai-Ilara is concerned with her comb and mirror and dismisses his grief. Her reaction breaks his idealised childhood attachment. He recognises Kel as the person who was closest and most loyal to him, and realises that he failed to see her love while she was beside him. [9, 10, 3]

The Joon cache and allies for the assault

The sealed cache supplies Kir with Joon armour, but Tui-Len warns him against relying on hatred alone. He gives him an amulet that can turn dangerous creatures into allies. Rad identifies suitable hunting grounds for a cyclops and a dragon. Their recruitment changes the military balance and answers the baron’s objection that his soldiers cannot face Firez’s necromancy in a direct assault. Virril finally orders the attack. Before the confrontation, Rad speaks of the quiet home and family he hopes to have when his secret work is finished. The cache is found in the valley Rad hopes to settle after the war. Dartas’s account of a nearby village destroyed by harpies points Kir to the rectangular amulet needed at its sealed entrance; Tui-Len supplies the remaining magical help. During the assault, Firez sends the city’s population, transformed into undead, against the Canian force. Kir must break through this army to reach the palace. [2, 11, 12, 13, 14, 7, 1, 15]
